lines.t: Verse 1
When the night surrounds my soul,
You are my light, You make me whole.
I will not fear the rising storm,
For in Your presence I am warm.
Pre-Chorus
You are my shield, You are my tower,
My hiding place, my saving power.
You lift my head, You hear my cry,
My heart will sing, my soul will rise.
Chorus
I will praise You in the morning light,
I will praise You through the darkest night.
YahuShua, You are holy,
You are my refuge, my song, my glory.
Verse 2
Though I walk through valleys deep,
You are the One who guards my feet.
You set a table in my fear,
Your steadfast love is always near.
Pre-Chorus
You are my shield, You are my tower,
My hiding place, my saving power.
You lift my head, You hear my cry,
My heart will sing, my soul will rise.
Chorus
I will praise You in the morning light,
I will praise You through the darkest night.
YahuShua, You are holy,
You are my refuge, my song, my glory.
Bridge
Let everything that has breath praise Your name,
The heavens declare forever the same.
You are righteous, You are near,
Your mercy endures, Your love casts out fear.
Final Chorus
I will praise You in the morning light,
I will praise You through the darkest night.
YahuShua, You are holy,
You are my refuge, my song, my glory.
